objective_value: <float> Total annualized system cost represented by the complete submitted plan.
model_variables: <dict, key: canonical variable name> Sparse complete witness; omitted variables are zero. Use Gurobi bracket syntax exactly as specified by model_variable_name_patterns.

<key: '{cluster_id}'>.resource_type: <str> Technology category of the resource cluster (such as natural_gas_CT, solar, wind, coal, nuclear, battery, or hydro).
<key: '{cluster_id}'>.zone: <int> Zone in which the resource cluster is located.
<key: '{cluster_id}'>.new_units: <float> Integer investment-count variable in the MILP: physical blocks for UC clusters and 1-MW increments for non-UC clusters.
<key: '{cluster_id}'>.new_MW: <float> New power capacity installed in the cluster, in MW.
<key: '{cluster_id}'>.retired_units: <float> Number of existing units retired from the cluster.
<key: '{cluster_id}'>.retired_MW: <float> Power capacity retired from the cluster, in MW.
<key: '{cluster_id}'>.total_capacity_MW: <float> Final installed power capacity of the cluster after investments and retirements, in MW.

<key: '{cluster_id}'>.new_units: <float> Integer energy-investment count in the MILP; non-UC storage uses 1-MWh increments.
<key: '{cluster_id}'>.new_MWh: <float> New energy capacity added to the storage cluster, in MWh.
<key: '{cluster_id}'>.total_energy_MWh: <float> Final installed energy capacity of the storage cluster, in MWh.

<key: '{line_id}'>.new_MW: <float> New transmission capacity added in integer 1-MW increments in the MILP.
<key: '{line_id}'>.total_capacity_MW: <float> Final installed transmission capacity of the line after expansion, in MW.
